name: AutoCorrect
description: Represents the AutoCorrect functionality in Microsoft PowerPoint.
example:
Sub HideAutoCorrectOpButton()

    With Application.AutoCorrect

        .DisplayAutoCorrectOptions = msoFalse

        .DisplayAutoLayoutOptions = msoFalse

    End With

End Sub

properties.name: DisplayAutoCorrectOptions
properties.description: Determines whether Microsoft PowerPoint should display the AutoCorrect Options button. Read/write.

properties.name: DisplayAutoLayoutOptions
properties.description: Determines whether Microsoft PowerPoint should display the AutoLayout Options button. Read/write.
